data.title: Why U.S. Robotics Startups Are Stuffing Parts From China in Luggage
data.description: On a muggy morning in April, a venture capitalist from San Francisco arrived in China’s southern tech hub of Shenzhen with a long shopping list. His friends at U.S. robotic startups had asked him to bring back humanoids and various robotic components from China. He headed to Shenzhen’s ...
